<thought>To locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using the target molecule SMILES “CCCCCCCCCCCO” and the reaction criteria described (functional groups broken/formed and bonds formed/broken). This should return the template ID and its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCCCCCCCCCCO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
